description: Stores failure fingerprints and resolved hints from tasks that failed after max retries. Keyed by (capability + error_type + input_fingerprint).
instructions: When a task fails after max retries or escalates, store its FailureContext in the guild store.
Key: hash of (capability + error_type + input_fingerprint prefix). Value: { error_message, resolution_hint, count, first_seen, last_seen }.
If the same failure pattern is seen again, increment count and update last_seen.
Resolution hints can be added manually by operators or automatically if a subsequent retry succeeds with adjusted input.
